speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: So I am supposed to persuade you to donate all thirty of your cents to a charity called Save the Children

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: Oh, I believe I've heard of them. What kind of work do they do?

speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: They promote childrens rights, provide relief and helps support children in developing countries

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: Do you know if they keep track of the effectiveness of their interventions?

speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: I believe they do. They also help fund education for children

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: That sounds admirable. I usually donate to global health charities (like the Against Malaria Foundation) because it's highly cost effective. Policy intervention is also important, but it's harder to know if it's worthwhile/will be successful...

speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: Totally understandable. It is easier to donate to something when there is tangible evidence of its success. I think helping children have access to an education will be beneficial to the entire world in the long run

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: By the way, on my side I'm told I can donate anything from $0-$2. So donating $0.30 sounds reasonable.

speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: I think that is very reasonable, and every little bit helps.

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: I would be interested to know what different programs their funding goes towards. Do they publish a budget?

speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: They actually do, I just looked on their website. It has a lot of information that I didnt expect them to make public

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: That's great! It's encouraging when a charity is transparent. I assume it's a 501.3(c)?

speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: It looks like it, only 5% of their donations go to management so I believe they operate as a non profit. Which is wonderful

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: Do you have a favorite non-profit? :P

speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: I should probably say this one but I donate to animal shelters mainly haha

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: Oh nice. I'd also like to look into donating more to animal welfare charities. I know there's some philosophical disagreement about this, but I prefer to diversify my charitable 'investments' as it were.

speaker: AY4EQTZ5Y77TT
text: That makes sense! So, you felt like donating 30 cents was fair?

speaker: A04033602UB6ODGE30VNO
text: Yep! Good talking with you.
